properties.name: First Landing State Park & Virginia Beach Coast (Southeast Virginia)
properties.description: The Atlantic coast at the mouth of the Chesapeake Bay: First Landing State Park at Cape Henry — Virginia's most-visited state park (~2,888 acres of maritime forest, cypress swamp and dune) with the Bald Cypress, Cape Henry and Long Creek trails — plus the northern Virginia Beach oceanfront. Terrain is near sea level, so elevation profiles are correctly flat.
properties.bbox_comment: [west, south, east, north] in decimal degrees (WGS84). Wraps First Landing State Park and Cape Henry with the north Virginia Beach oceanfront to the south.
properties.origins_comment: Named search origins the frontend picker offers for this region (Phase 2: config-driven — adding/removing an origin is a config edit, not a frontend deploy). key is the wire/UI identifier; lat/lon WGS84.
properties.min_fetch_counts_comment: Per-source raw-fetch floors (a source fetching below its floor aborts the run BEFORE any load/prune — a truncated/partial fetch can't self-wipe). Only OSM (geometry) is floor-gated here; USGS is 3DEP elevation enrichment and never fetches. RECALIBRATED 2026-07-13: the original 250 was a conservative pre-calibration guess made with no live Overpass baseline; an independent Overpass verification against this bbox found exactly 81 named trail-highway ways (matching the pipeline's own fetch: 62 kept + 19 filtered = 81), so 250 was gating out a real, complete fetch. New floor is 60, ~70% of the 81-way measured inventory, per the calibration convention used for other pilot regions. Env-overridable via ADVENTURE_FETCH_MIN_OSM.
